qa_flags.question: Gokul (JPMorgan): given the mid-40s% data center AI CAGR guided earlier this year through 2029, is there anything that should change that number given stronger demand signals?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Management confirms the number is 'a little bit better' than mid-40s but declines to give an updated figure now, deferring to 'beginning of next year' when they have a clearer picture.

qa_flags.question: Gokul (JPMorgan): could you give us some idea of how much CoWoS capacity you'll be building next year?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO repeats that front-end and back-end AI capacity is very tight and TSMC is working hard to narrow the gap, but explicitly declines to give the real number, deferring to next year.

qa_flags.question: Krish Sankar (TD Cowen): can you quantify how much wafer demand/revenue 1 gigawatt of AI data center capacity translates to for TSMC?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO gives the customer's own capex-per-gigawatt figure but states TSMC is 'not ready to share' its own wafer/revenue content number, citing project-to-project variation.

qa_flags.question: Bruce Lu (Goldman Sachs) asked if the next 3-year capex could scale to roughly USD 200 billion, given 2021's 3-year/USD 100 billion precedent and now-stronger demand.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO confirms capex will be 'significantly higher' than the prior 3-year USD 101 billion total but explicitly refuses to give an actual number.

qa_flags.question: Sunny Lin (UBS) asked what percentage of 2026 revenue 2-nanometer is expected to contribute, following TSMC's past practice of guiding new-node revenue percentage.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO declines to give a percentage, saying it is 'less meaningful' now that the overall revenue base is much bigger, offering only a qualitative 'bigger node' framing instead.

qa_flags.question: Zheng Lu (Goldman Sachs) asked what token-consumption growth and gigawatt-of-compute assumptions underlie the 5-year AI accelerator revenue CAGR guidance.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO says he 'loses track' of the exact token/gigawatt math and pivots to saying wafer supply, not power, is today's bottleneck, without answering the specific figures asked.

qa_flags.question: So do you think your faster ramp-up of capacity can kind of win some of these customers back?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 只重複制式說法「蓋新廠要2到3年、沒有捷徑」，未正面回答是否／如何／何時能贏回該客戶（Terafab／Tesla），也未給任何機率或時間表。

qa_flags.question: Charles Shi 追問特定客戶下一代 LPU 產品（目前在 Samsung Foundry 生產）是否有機會贏回
qa_flags.response_pattern: IR 主持人 Jeff Su 先明說這是「非常具體的客戶與產品，我們通常不評論」；CEO 僅答「正與該客戶合作下一代 LPU」，未證實或否認是否已拿到訂單、是否真能搶回業務。
